We study the problem of recognizing visual entities from the textual descriptions of their classes. Specifically, given birds' images with free-text descriptions of their species, we learn to classify images as either Pied Woodpecker (PWP) or Red-tailed Hawk (RH). We apply a Bayesian Bayes approach to classifying the classifications made by humans and a cluster analysis algorithm in order to explore differences between their approaches.
